title: Critical PHP Vulnerabilities Trigger Global Web Outages
content_md: Note: Create your free account in SOCFortress Signals ( https://signals.socfortress.co/ ) for: Global intelligence Security advisories, search & filters Microsoft Patch Tuesday & CISA KEV views Threat actor, malware & IOC views Source references, visualizations & timeline Intro The cybersecurity landscape faced a major disruption when maintainers of the PHP scripting language issued urgent warnings regarding two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities , rated 9.2 out of 10. In response to the threat, governments globally issued strict security alerts , while numerous organizations and prominent enterprises proactively took their websites offline to prevent potential breaches. Security researchers revealed that these severe flaws were originally uncovered through OpenAI’s artificial intelligence tools , which bad actors are now leveraging to rapidly craft exploitation scripts. Compounding this digital emergency, experts noted that millions of legacy websites run outdated, unsupported versions of PHP that will never receive patches, leaving them critically exposed. Consequently, industry professionals emphasized that speed and comprehensive asset tracking are vital for organizations to locate hidden PHP instances and secure their networks before attackers strike.
